# Shawon.dev

> Portfolio of MD Shawon Molla — full-stack software engineer working on high-concurrency web platforms, distributed services, and AI orchestration systems.

This file describes the site's purpose, structure, and key content for language models and AI agents. The site is a single-page React application; all navigation is by URL fragment, not by separate documents.

## Who this is for

Hiring managers, engineering leads, and technical recruiters evaluating MD Shawon Molla for full-time software engineering roles. Remote, or Dhaka, Bangladesh (UTC+6).

## Sections

The entire portfolio is one document. These fragment URLs address individual sections:

- [`%SITE_ORIGIN%/`](%SITE_ORIGIN%/) — Hero, selected work in motion, about, core disciplines.
- [`%SITE_ORIGIN%/#projects`](%SITE_ORIGIN%/#projects) — Case studies with architecture, telemetry metrics, and stack analysis. Filterable by category: `#projects?category=fullstack`, `#projects?category=aiml`, `#projects?category=backend`.
- [`%SITE_ORIGIN%/#experience`](%SITE_ORIGIN%/#experience) — Engineering timeline, credentials, certifications.
- [`%SITE_ORIGIN%/#contact`](%SITE_ORIGIN%/#contact) — Contact channels, email, and an enquiry form.

## Projects

- **AmarShop** — Enterprise multi-tenant commerce platform. MERN, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker.
- **SupportPilot AI** — Autonomous customer support infrastructure with LangChain agent orchestration and hybrid RAG retrieval.
- **Online24Pharmacy** — Production medicine delivery system: inventory analytics, prescription management, order lifecycle.

## Core disciplines

Full-stack web systems · AI/ML & RAG pipelines · Backend & distributed SaaS · Cloud-native infrastructure · Database design.

## Technical stack

TypeScript, React, Vite, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Prisma, pgvector, Redis, Docker, Vitest, Three.js / WebGL, Tailwind CSS.

## Notes

- Structured data (Schema.org `@graph`) is embedded in the page head and updated per section.
- OpenGraph and Twitter card metadata point to a 1200×630 social image at `%SITE_ORIGIN%/og-image.png`.
- The WebGL background is decorative; all content remains available without it.
- The site honours `prefers-reduced-motion`: all motion is removed and scrolling becomes instant.
